name: Valentina Herrera
bio:
Valentina's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Originally trained as an aerospace engineer in Buenos Aires, a chance encounter at a local racing event ignited a passion that shifted her career trajectory. She found the precision and problem-solving required in racing resonated deeply with her engineering sensibilities. After cutting her teeth in local touring car series, she moved to Europe to hone her skills in advanced simulator technology. 

Valentina's approach to simulator engineering is deeply pragmatic. She believes in rigorous testing and data analysis to ensure the simulator accurately reflects real-world conditions. Her ability to quickly identify discrepancies between simulation and track performance has made her a valuable asset to Chip Ganassi Racing. She's known for her meticulous attention to detail and her ability to translate driver feedback into actionable adjustments for the simulator setup. Her colleagues appreciate her direct communication style and her focus on results.

What sets Valentina apart is her relentless pursuit of accuracy. She's never satisfied with 'good enough' and constantly seeks ways to refine the simulation model. This dedication, combined with her experience in diverse racing environments, makes her a highly sought-after simulator engineer.
